mineral_spectral_indices.target_feature: Low surface albedo of exposed coal opencast faces and carbonaceous waste
Distinguishes coal seam excavations from surrounding forest canopy

scientific_guardrail: CRITICAL SCIENTIFIC PRINCIPLE: Optical satellite sensors (Sentinel-2) measure surface surface reflectance only. NEVER infer underground coal seams from optical remote-sensing imagery. Subsurface coal deposits occur in stratigraphically buried Gondwana formations and require borehole geophysical logging.
data_authenticity_notice: Authentic Bottom-of-Atmosphere (BOA) surface reflectance pixels decompressed and processed from S2B_44QME_20240330_0_L2A. Spatial circular buffer clipped, 10m bands resampled to 20m, SCL cloud masked, and zero-division guarded.
